text:
Hello! I will help you set up your server, one step at a time.
First, what would you like to name it?

Nice name! Next, choose the client version to support.
Before playing, import its client data.
Still downloading? You can skip this and import it later in Settings.

Next, choose where to store your data.
For longer-term public hosting, I recommend MySQL.
For occasional games with friends, SQLite is convenient.
The help page explains MySQL installation.

The database is configured!
Now create an administrator account.
Keep the username and password safe: you will use them to sign in to the management page.

Your server is now configured.
If you need more information, check Help.
Finally, add this server in Launcher and get ready to go!
See you soon in Boom Hill!
